common_isospin: Isospin-symmetric lattice matrix elements; physical external masses. Each search limit is used separately.
source_matching: Symmetric ordinary up mass, complete three-family anti-neutrinos, no heavy five-bar suppression, or separately budgeted. Quark row moduli transported as at the 1799 matching surface; other gauge-only Wilson transport, no additional baryon-violating amplitude.
mass_matching: Threshold masses of conjugate superfields are physical masses in the one-loop step approximation. Z denotes the (3,2,1/6) pair in a 15, not the electroweak Z. T,S and Z freely split in the two-fragment example; a single adjoint need not generate those three masses.
